summary: Tested Evidence Library file upload feature. All 14 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified including file upload dialog, file metadata display, download functionality, and demo account restrictions.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

backend: GET /api/evidence returns evidence items with file metadata
GET /api/evidence/{id}/download returns 404 for evidence without file
DELETE /api/evidence/{id} removes DB record and file from disk
POST /api/evidence with file over 50MB returns 413 error
Upload PNG image file type - success
frontend: Evidence cards show paperclip icon for items with files
Evidence cards show filename and file size
Download button visible for items with files
Add Evidence dialog shows file upload dropzone
File selection displays filename and size in dialog
File upload and evidence creation works end-to-end
Success toast shown after adding evidence
Delete button hidden for demo accounts
Add Evidence dialog blocked for demo accounts with toast message
Demo banner visible for demo accounts

action_items: Minor: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent in EvidencePage.js for accessibility
seed_data_creation: test-upload@grc.com user has 2 evidence items (1 with file test_evidence.txt, 1 without file). Demo org has 5 pre-seeded evidence items without files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Evidence Library file upload feature fully working. Backend stores files in /app/backend/uploads/ with UUID filenames. Max file size 50MB enforced. Demo accounts blocked from POST/DELETE with 403. Non-demo admin users can upload, download, and delete evidence with files. File metadata (original_name, size, stored_name, content_type) stored in MongoDB evidence_library collection.

file_upload.multipart_form_data: Working - POST /api/evidence accepts file via multipart/form-data
file_upload.metadata_only: Working - POST /api/evidence works without file attachment
file_upload.file_storage: Working - Files stored in /app/backend/uploads/ with UUID names
file_upload.file_types: Working - PDF, PNG, TXT tested successfully

file_download.content_disposition: Working - Filename preserved in download header
file_download.error_handling: Working - 404 for missing evidence or no file attached

file_deletion.db_and_disk: Working - DELETE removes both MongoDB record and file from disk

frontend_ui.dropzone: Working - File upload dropzone in Add Evidence dialog
frontend_ui.file_preview: Working - Selected file shows name and size
frontend_ui.file_metadata_display: Working - Cards show paperclip icon, filename, size
frontend_ui.download_button: Working - Download button visible for items with files
frontend_ui.demo_restrictions: Working - Delete hidden, Add blocked for demo accounts
